title: Prepare an order
lead: Review the offer and choose fulfillment. The seller confirms prices and stock when preparing the order. Preparation does not initiate any payment.
ordersLead: Your private preparations, reservations and deadlines. A preparation does not confirm a payment.
unavailable: This preparation is unavailable. No previous result is displayed.
failed: The response could not be confirmed. Check the status before creating another preparation.
refused: This action is currently unavailable. The server will recheck your access, conditions and availability.
optionsLead: The following options and fees come from the seller’s current configuration.
optionsUnavailable: Fulfillment options cannot currently be confirmed.
quantityHint: From 1 to 999. The seller will check actual stock.
addressHint: Enter only the address needed for this delivery. It is never copied from your profile.
consent: I agree to share this preparation’s information with the seller to check the offer and reserve stock under the displayed conditions.
uncertainIntent: A request was sent. Its choices are kept only on this screen. Resume this same request or check your preparations; do not create another request to bypass the wait.
pendingExists: You already have a preparation in progress for this storefront. Check it before creating another.
notPurchasable: This offer does not provide an exact amount to prepare. Review its conditions or choose an eligible variant.
unconfirmedTotal: The final total and deadline will appear after the seller responds.
noPayment: Preparation does not initiate any payment.
consumedHint: The server reports that this reservation has been allocated to the order. Check the payment and order tracking for their current status.
unknownHint: The result is still unknown. Check its status or resume the same attempt; another request could create a duplicate.
heldHint: The seller reports a reservation until the displayed deadline. This does not constitute payment.
expiredHint: The deadline has passed. The reservation must no longer be considered available. Check the server status.
expiringSoon: This reservation expires on {{date}}. It cannot be extended: finish before then; afterwards, you will need to prepare again.
reconfirmHint: The price, quantity, fees or fulfillment conditions changed. Compare the conditions before explicitly accepting them. No changes are accepted automatically.
releasedHint: The release of this preparation has been recorded.
rejectedHint: This preparation was not accepted. No payment was triggered.
reconfirmConsent: I compared the changes and explicitly accept the new total of {{amount}} to request a new preparation.
releaseConsent: I want to abandon this preparation and request release of its reservation.
empty: You have no preparations on this page.
scope: Up to {{count}} preparations are displayed per page.

validation.quantity: Enter a whole number from 1 to 999.
validation.country: Delivery in this version is limited to Gabon.
validation.text: This field contains an invalid character.
validation.choiceChanged: This option is no longer available. Reload the conditions before continuing.
